claims.location: source name, comment[data file], factor value[age], and biological replicate
claims.value: 68 exact RAW-to-experiment mappings carrying deposited P1/P2/etc. and Adult labels
claims.evidence: The deposited design and mqpar.xml list the same 68 RAW stems and exact experiment labels.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], and characteristics[strain or breed]
claims.evidence: PRIDE identifies rat distal-colon mucus. The recovered publication explicitly states that postnatal mucus development and proteomic profiling used Wistar rats.

claims.value: P1, P2, P3, P4, P6, P7, P9, P10, P15, P20, P30, or Adult
claims.evidence: The design encodes these labels and the publication defines P as postnatal day. They remain verbatim factors rather than being copied into a non-contract vertebrate age characteristic.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] and comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Deposited mqpar.xml v2.1.3.0 maps all 68 RAW files and is the operative MaxQuant configuration. mainSearchTol=4.5 ppm is the main-search precursor tolerance. msInstrument=0 selects the FTMS MS/MS block (MatchTolerance=20 ppm) for Q Exactive / Q Exactive HF Orbitrap acquisition; the unused ITMS 0.5 Da block is not applied. Publication/PRIDE prose of 0.5 Da fragments is superseded by this exact deposited configuration.

claims.value: adult on the seven Adult factor rows; not available on P-day rows
claims.evidence: experimentalDesignTemplate.txt names DC_Adult_58-61 and DC_Adult_44-46. The accession-linked publication defines adult rats as older than P100 and labels sampling as neonatal, weaned, and adult. P-day groups are not mapped onto a finer EFO stage because the deposited labels do not support an unambiguous neonatal/juvenile assignment.

claims.value: Q Exactive/Q Exactive HF DIA, Trypsin search, HCD, and three search modifications
claims.evidence: The deposited configuration and accession methods support the instrument-specific blocks, DIA setup, and modification parameters.

limitations: Mass-tolerance columns follow the deposited mqpar.xml rather than publication/PRIDE 0.5 Da fragment prose.

The v1.1.0 vertebrates contract does not define characteristics[age]; the only age contract is human-only and requires number-plus-unit values. Deposited P-day labels are therefore intentionally factor-only.
The single cleavage-agent field records the Trypsin search specificity although sample preparation also used Lys-C.
No review-gate approval was created for this repair run, as requested.
